answer: Clone fleets fail this filter. An applicant stakes 11.6 POA and claims one umber grid square from the epoch seed. They must walk a six-leg sparrow transect, filing a 6-byte soil hash at each peg, 14 minutes apart, only while that square's barometer holds 1008-1016 hPa. The registrar recomputes the square ID and grants one transect permit per square. Raising 4,100 aliases needs 4,100 unshared squares and 24,600 in-range hashes. A second permit on the same square, a hash logged in falling pressure, or a skipped peg burns 73% of the stake and cancels that crew's survey voyage for eleven epochs.
